ink and wash illustration, loose expressive ink lines with soft watery colour washes, light airy composition, gentle bleeding edges, delicate and calm. Chinnu the squirrel cheering at the edge of a lily pond as a tiny leaf boat carrying a yellow flower floats across, Kavin the little elephant smiling beside her. Mira the woman: a woman in her thirties with short dark hair, a mustard scarf, a grey coat and a calm, curious expression.
